knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Moving plant is not worked around, and barriers are not moved.
The induction communicates the site controls. Task controls are confirmed separately.
Changed hazards are reported promptly through the written channel.

practicalCriteria: Traces the permitted access and evacuation route on a supplied site plan.
Withdraws and requests a revised pedestrian route when a simulated plant route crosses the area.
Reports a simulated changed hazard in writing with location and time.
passRule: Route traced correctly, withdrawal demonstrated, and changed hazard reported in writing. Observed by an assessor.
